title: Contribution: PDF report generator
body:
Hi,
I'm addressing the issue that frequently, doctors would like to see reports that usually come from the proprietary software. I believe many users of xdrip+ are using this app also as they do not want their sensitive data being stored and evaluated in some corporation's cloud system without any control whatsoever.
Long story short, I've written a PDF report generator for exactly this purpose. It parses the sqlite db directly and generates day plots as well as the daily pattern with percentiles that all doctors seem to love, plus carbs/bolus and ratio plots, Text stats and so on.
Still alpha-ish and only tested with what I could find for testing, but the results look reasonable.
I'd be happy to contribute and also continue development if there is a need for this.
However, I'm not quite sure if this approach (PC based, python) is the way to go here or if this should rather be implemented directly as a function in the app.

It still seems to be a bit of an overkill to set up a locally hosted nightscout instance just to create reports if you have no other use for it -- also if the collector is not intended to be connected to the internet.

FWIW, I just uploaded my project in its current status to https://github.com/gfornax/xdrip-report

u'r right - when u really just need it for reporting a complete nightscout nodeJS seems overkill. But we also use NS for follower synchronization (because our xdrip's running on lineage-ROM without any google apps and we also use IOS devices with can't follow xdrips that way), diabetes diary (and also as a backup for the diary) and even reporting.
The main reason for NS was:

Hi
nightscout's webgui will not differentiate between the insulin profiles - just the treatments are containing a NEW field "insulinInjections" which is a composite array containing the insulin name and the injected dose.
Nightscout reporter (the one u deployed) can use this new field and respect it in some (not all) reports.

To keep nightscout itself intact, i put the sum of all injected dose at a time as injected insulin dose - thats why every "not respecting reporting" will use it as bolus (because basal is not registered in xdrip+ when in FIT)

To make clear - ALL reportings (those within xdrip+, nightscout webui & reporting, nightscout-reporter but even Spike and other frontend/backend...) have to be patched to fully support multiple insulin. 
As i'm just using xdrip as frontend and nightscout-reporter for reporting and documenting i will patch nightscouts gui's as secondary precedence.....
